w10_T4_001512: In the morning a skater timed each lap at 52 seconds, a little under a minute. She skated 7 laps in every set and completed 8 sets. In the afternoon she skated a second session exactly like the morning one, making 2 sessions. In the evening she added a 37-second sprint. How many seconds did she skate in total?
w10_T4_001515: Abe earns 212 cents an hour at the garage plus 51 cents an hour in tips. He works 3 hours a day for 7 days, which comes to a little over fifty-five dollars. His friend Bea, who works half as many hours, earns less per hour than Abe. Abe then spends 4886 cents on boots. At the fair every cent he has left buys 6 tokens, and every token scores 4 points on the ring toss. How many points can Abe score?
w10_T4_001516: A bird sanctuary had 238 birds. 79 birds arrived during the migration, and then 105 flew away. The sanctuary covers 12 hectares. 13 birds were moved to a zoo, and 175 flew south. Then 24 birds hatched, and 37 more were released into the wild. How many birds are at the sanctuary now?
w10_T4_001517: In the morning a school fair had sold 238 raffle tickets, and by noon 74 more were sold. Every ticket cost 5 cents, and the money was shared equally among 3 clubs. The fair ran for 6 hours. In the afternoon the chess club received a 13-cent donation, and in the evening it received 3 cents more. How many cents did the chess club end up with?
w10_T4_001518: Dan collects 109 cans every day from the park, 33 cans from the beach, and 65 cans from the school, spending about half an hour at each place. The bins are emptied at 7. He does this for 3 days, and on the last day a neighbour gives him 65 cans. How many cans has Dan collected?
w10_T4_001522: Cy grew 45 bean plants and sold 25 of them. He waters the rest twice a day. Each of his remaining plants gave 6 pods, and every pod held 4 beans. His friend Dot, who grew fewer beans than Cy, gave him 22 of her beans. How many beans does Cy have?
w10_T4_001523: In the morning Eve counted that she earns 107 cents an hour at the stall plus 72 cents an hour in tips, and she works 3 hours a day. She worked this way for 7 days. In the afternoon her twin Fin showed that he had earned exactly the same over the same 7 days, so together the 2 of them had more than seventy-five dollars. In the evening a customer gave them 24 cents. How many cents did Eve and Fin have altogether?
w10_T4_001526: Gus sells 7 bookmarks at 27 cents each and spends 80 cents on a drink. His stall is 2 metres wide. His mother then gives him twice what he has, doubling his money. At the fair every cent buys 4 tokens, every token scores 7 points, and every point earns 3 stars. How many stars does Gus earn?
w10_T4_001528: In the morning a grocer unpacked 8 crates with 121 pears in each, and a farmer brought 71 more pears. In the afternoon 93 pears were sold. In the evening 65 pears arrived from an orchard, and then a neighbour dropped off 17 more. How many pears did the grocer have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001529: In the morning Eli had 149 cents and spent 91 cents on a bus ticket. At the arcade every cent he had left bought 6 tokens, and he won 33 tokens on the first machine. In the afternoon he spent 124 tokens on racing games and 138 tokens on a claw machine, while his friend Fay had fewer tokens than Eli. In the evening the arcade replaced every token Eli still had with 2 tokens. How many tokens does Eli have?
w10_T4_001531: Gia had 74 cans for the recycling drive. She threw out 38 that were crushed. Her friend Hal, who had collected fewer cans than Gia, gave her 39 cans. The depot pays 8 cents for every can. Gia collected exactly the same number of cans each week for 5 weeks. She then received a 50-cent bonus. How many cents did Gia receive?
w10_T4_001532: A jar held 150 sweets. Ivo's class ate 83 sweets at the party, and 34 sweets were given to the teachers, who check the jar twice a week. Then 15 sweets were added from another jar. The rest were shared equally among 4 helpers. How many sweets did Ivo, one of the helpers, get?
w10_T4_001540: A shelf in the shop held 136 candles. On Monday 30 candles were sold. On Tuesday 85 were sent to a wedding. On Wednesday 4 candles were broken and thrown away. On Thursday 7 candles were sold, and on Friday 1 more was sold. How many candles are on the shelf now?
w10_T4_001548: In the morning a warehouse held 137 boxes, and 56 boxes were shipped out, then 8 more. The warehouse has 5 doors. In the afternoon 37 boxes arrived, and 13 boxes were sent back to a supplier. In the evening the manager opened the remaining boxes: each held 4 packs, and each pack held 9 pens. How many pens were in the remaining boxes?
w10_T4_001553: Jo earns 47 cents a day for feeding the cat, 60 cents a day for walking the dog, and 78 cents a day for washing up. She saves all of it for 7 days. She then shares her savings equally among herself and 4 friends. After that her grandmother gives Jo 13 cents. How many cents does Jo have?
w10_T4_001562: Kim gets 81 cents a day in pocket money and earns 20 cents a day for chores. Each day she spends 60 cents on the bus, a little over half a dollar, gets 22 cents back from bottles, and spends 58 cents on a snack. She saves whatever is left every day for 8 days. How many cents does Kim save?
w10_T4_001564: A teacher had 152 stickers and bought 48 more. She shared them equally among 4 pupils. The class has a dozen tables. Kai traded each of his stickers for 3 smaller stickers. He then got 61 stickers from a friend, and gave 198 stickers to his sister. How many stickers does Kai have?
w10_T4_001567: Lee had 119 cents. He spent 99 cents on a comic. He gave 18 cents to his friend Mo, who then had more money than Lee. At the arcade every cent Lee had left bought 6 tokens. He spent 4 tokens on one game and 3 on another, and then won 8 tokens. How many tokens does Lee have?
w10_T4_001583: A farmer sows 51 seeds in each row and 3 rows in each bed, and adds 23 seeds around the edge of every bed. There are 9 beds in a field and 3 fields on the farm, which she checks twice a day. She also sows 20 seeds in a tub. Every seed grows into a plant with 3 pods. How many pods does the farm produce?
w10_T4_001586: Nat had 201 cents and earned 47 cents more, nearly two and a half dollars. He gave half of his money to his sister. At the arcade every cent he had left bought 4 tokens. He spent 318 tokens on racing games and 174 tokens on a crane game. The attendant then doubled the tokens he had left. How many tokens does Nat have?
w10_T4_001589: Ola's homework took 38 minutes for maths, 25 minutes for reading, 74 minutes for a science project, 35 minutes for history, and 42 minutes for music, which is a little over three and a half hours in all. She has 6 subjects at school. How many minutes did Ola spend on homework?
w10_T4_001592: In the morning a farm packed 42 apples in each basket, 3 baskets on each cart, and filled 8 carts. The farm has 20 trees. In the afternoon the apples were shared equally among 6 market stalls. In the evening Pia split her stall's apples equally into 3 boxes. How many apples were in Pia's first box?
w10_T4_001599: Ria had 89 cents, less than a dollar. She spent 86 cents on a pen, and gave 2 cents to her brother Sam, who then had more money than Ria. The shop is 4 streets away. At the fair every cent she had left bought 5 tokens, and she then won 42 tokens. How many tokens does Ria have?
w10_T4_001600: Tom practised the guitar for 44 minutes on Monday, 47 minutes on Tuesday, and 45 minutes on Wednesday, a little over two hours in all. His teacher asked him to do half of that total again next week, spread equally over 4 days. How many minutes should Tom practise on each of those days?
w10_T4_001607: In the morning Uma earned 204 cents an hour at the bakery and worked 4 hours, more than her friend Vic earned that day. In the afternoon her aunt gave her twice what she had, doubling her money, and Uma spent 988 cents on a scarf. In the evening every cent she had left bought 6 tokens at the arcade, and she spent 3276 tokens on games. How many tokens does Uma have left?
